spans.s: (II)--the son of सुनक्षत्र and father of अन्तरिक्ष. भा. IX. १२. 12
(III)--a son of दुर्वार्क्षी and वृक. भा. IX. २४. ४३.
(V)--a son of Bharata founded पुष्करावती as his capital in गान्धार. Br. III. ६३. १९०; वा. २९. 8; ८८. १८९.

(VII)--a Kingdom watered by the सीता; fit for श्राद्ध.
2: Br. III. १३. ४०.

(I)--clouds of the पक्षज variety. Br. II. २२. ४०.
(II)--the Brahmana caste of the क्रौञ्चद्- वीप. Vi.
--an elephant at one of the four cardinal points to maintain the balance of the worlds. भा. V. २०. ३९.

--the island twice the दधिमण्डोद in size, and surrounded by sea of fresh water: named after a huge lotus with golden petal intended to be ब्रह्मा's throne: called after the King पुष्पवाहन of Rathantara- kalpa; here is the hill चित्रसानु. There is only one moun- tain मानसोत्तर in the middle of this द्वीप, dividing it into portions East and West. On it in the four directions are the cities of gods like Indra. On its top rotates the wheel of the Sun's chariot which makes the year of men and the day of gods. वीतिहोत्र, a son of Priyavrata was the ruler who divided it among his two sons. ब्रह्मा is worshipped [page२-364+ ३७] here;
1: भा.

years. No caste or Vedas: worship banyan tree: कश्यप performed his अश्वमेध and वालि defeated रावण;
2: Br. II. १४. १४; १९. १०८-26, १४०-1;

. ७२-86, ९२.
one of the seven continents of which Savana was the first King. His sons महावीर and धातुकि divided it between them.
4: Ib.
--a hill in भारतवर्ष: felt the influence of हिरण्यकशिपु. M. १६३. ८८.
--abode of पुष्कर, a wonderful lotus moving at will, gained by पुस्पवाहन's self denial in his previous birth. M. १००. ३०.
--the son of सृचन्द्र; an able charioteer; used वायव्यास्त्रम् against परशुराम who attacked him with ब्रह्मास्त्रम् and cut him into two with the परशु. Br. III. ४०. 1.
(I)--the capital of पुष्कर, son of Bharata. Br. III. ६३. १९१; वा. ८८. १९०.

--a group of rain-bearing clouds, born of the wings of the mountains shorn by Indra; description of; rain at the commencement of Pralaya and are instru- mental in putting an end to them also. M. १२५. ११-15; वा. ५१. ३७-40.
--the son of उरुक्षव and विशाला, became a Brahmana, and one of the three best महऋषिस् among the काव्यस्. M. ४९. ३९.
(I)--the queen of व्युष्ट, and mother of चक्षुष्. भा. IV. १३. १४.
(III)--see वारुणी--daughter of progenitor वीरण; wife of चाक्षुष. Br. II. ३६. १०२. Vi. I. १३. 3.
--a son of Bharata. भा. IX. ११. १२; Vi.
(I)--a daughter of दक्ष, and a wife of Dharma: gave birth to Smaya (लाभ-वा। प्।). भा.
(II)--one of the nine देवीस् attending on Soma. Br. II. २६. ४५; III. ६५. २६; वा. ९०. २५.
(IV)--a son of Vasudeva and मदिरा. Br. III. ७१. १७२; वा. ९६. १७०.
(V) अन्गिरस्--a sage of the epoch of the third सावर्ण Manu. Br.
(IX)--a Goddess enshrined at देवदारु forest. M. १३. ४७.
(VI)--a God of the Rohita गण. Br.
--the son of हिरण्यनाभ and father of Dhruva- sandhi. Br. III. ६३. २०९.

(III)--a Mt. north of the महाभद्र;
1: वा. ३६. ३२; ३८. ७१.
the residence of sages.
2: Ib. ३९. ६२.
--a Mt. in भारतवर्ष. Br. II. १६. २२; वा. ४५. ९२.
--a R. from the Malaya hill. M. ११४. ३०.
--a R. originating from the Malaya hills. Br. II. १६. ३६; वा. ४५. १०५.
(I)--attacked the Asura followers of Bali. भा. VIII. २१. १७. [page२-368+ २३]
(II)--a यक्ष; a son of देवजनी. Br.
(III)--the elephant of the साम fold (बृहत्साम) with six tusks; his sons are ताम्रपर्ण and others roaming in groups. Br.
(V)--to be worshipped before the com- mencement of house and palace building operations. M. २५३. २६; २५५. 9; २६८. १५.
--the God of love; see Madana. M. १५४. २४५.
--R. (also पुष्पवहा)--on its banks in the हिमालयस्, मार्कण्डेय performed तपस्। भा.
--a pleasure garden to which went Kardama and देवहूती. भा. III. २३. ४०.

(I)--the commander-in-chief of the Mauryan King बृहद्रथ; did away with his master and became King; ruled for six (sixty वा। प्।) years; had eight sons, of whom the first ruled for seven years. Br. III. ७४. १५०; वा. ९९. ३३७-8.
(II)--a King of the महिषस्, ruled for six years. Br. III. ७४. १८७; वा. ९९. ३७४.
--a royal dynasty after the बाह्लिकस् in the Kingdom of Magadha. Vi. IV. २४. ५८.
--(पुष्पमित्र-ब्र्। प्।) a क्षत्रिय King after the बाह्लिकस्. भा.
(I)--the son of Satyahita, and father of Jahu. भा. IX. २२. 7.
(II)--a Mt. in कुशद्वीप. Br. II. १९. ५५; वा. ४९. ५०. Vi.
(IV)--the righteous son of ऋषभ (वृषभ- वि। प्।) Father of Satyahita. वा. ९९. २२४; Vi. IV. १९. ८२.

--a King of Rathantara Kalpa; ब्रह्मा was pleased at his तपस् and gave him a golden lotus; after him came the 7th द्वीप, पुष्करद्वीप (s.v); he got a vehicle of पुष्पवाहन which took him to any place; his wife was लावण्यवती; once he met the sage प्राचेतस् and asked him the reason for his wealth etc. He said that in the previous birth he was a hunter and owing to a distressing famine, he could not get anything to eat; so he plucked some lotus flowers and went to the वैदिश city for selling them; none offered to buy; soon he heard a musical sound near by; going in that direction he saw a courtesan engaged in विभूतिद्वादशि व्रतम्; there, he gave all flowers needed for the performance of the vow and did not take gold or food offered in return; he felt no thirst or hunger; and be- came changed at that sight; for that service he became King and the courtesan प्रीती, wife of the Lord of love. M. १००. 1-३२. [page२-371+ २२]
--a R. in भारतवर्ष: felt the prowess of हिरण्यकशीपु. M. १६३. ६४.
--विष्णु's wedding present to कामेश्वर. Br. IV. १५. १९.
--a son of Vatsara; had two queens, प्रभा and दोषा. Each of them had three sons. भा. IV. १३. १२-13.
--a daughter of माल्यवान् and one of the four wives of विश्रवस्; her sons, Mahodara, महापार्श्व, (महापाम्शु-वा। प्।) Prahasta, and Khara; daughter Kum- भीनसी. Br.
(I)--a नक्षत्र in ऐरावति vi1thi. भा. V. २३. 6; वा. ६६. ४८.
(II)--a son of हिरण्यनाभ and father of Dhruvasandhi. भा. IX. १२. 5; वा. ८८. २०९; Vi.
(III)--the month sacred to Bhaga, etc. भा. XII. ११. ४२. [page२-372+ २९]
--a term for Kali-yuga, evils of. M. १४४. ३०-48.

--Commander-in-chief of बृहद्रथ, the Mauryan King; killed his own master and usurped the throne. He was a शुन्ग and his line was therefore called the शुन्गस्. Father of Agnimitra;
1: भा.
(I)--the name of the god of a division of the day; a Vasu. वा. ६६. ४३; १०६. ५९; Br.
(II)--a son of अदिती; childless. Laughed at शिव, enraged at दक्ष and was deprived of his teeth. भा.

(III)--the name of the sun in the month of Tapas (माघ);
1: भा. XII. ११. ३९; Br. II. २३. १२; २४. ३३.
an आदित्य.
2: Ib.

(V)--an आदित्य; a son of Diti;
1: वा. ६६. ६६;
(VI)--a deity with the sun in the शरत् season. वा. ५२. १२. Vi. II. १०. ११.

--a god who helped दक्ष in his sacrifice, was seized by चन्डीश. His teeth were pulled out by वीरभ- dra for laughing at शिव enraged at दक्ष; when शिव was reconciled, he agreed to eat the offering with the teeth of the sacrificer. भा.
--a कला of the moon. Br. IV. ३५. ९२.
